📰 General

Broncos Secure Dramatic Overtime Victory Over Seahawks, 17-14 •

The Denver Broncos defeated the Seattle Seahawks 17-14 in a tightly contested Thursday Night Football game that went into overtime. The Broncos maintained their impressive streak, having not lost a home game leading by 11 or more points in the fourth quarter since 2004. Seattle mounted a significant comeback, reducing a 11-point deficit in the fourth quarter to force the game into overtime. Sam Darnold’s interception ultimately sealed the victory for the Broncos.

🌍 World

Lula Secures Victory in Court Battle Against Meta’s Alleged Bolsonaro Bias •

Brazil’s President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won a key legal challenge against Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram. A Brazilian electoral court judge ordered Meta to implement immediate measures ensuring equal treatment for Lula and his opponent, former President Jair Bolsonaro, in the lead-up to the October 25th runoff election. The ruling stems from allegations that Meta’s algorithms favored Bolsonaro’s content. The court determined that unequal treatment could compromise the integrity of the electoral process.

🦅 US

Billy Joel Sells Motorcycle Collection Amid Health Update Following Diagnosis •

Singer Billy Joel is auctioning off his extensive motorcycle collection to raise funds following his diagnosis of normal pressure hydrocephalus. The New York native discussed the sale in an interview with The Hollywood Reporter, stating it’s a way to manage his condition. Joel revealed he’s selling the collection, which includes over 200 motorcycles, to help with medical expenses and ongoing care. The auction is being held in partnership with the Watermill Foundation.

💰 Business

KFC Switches to Coca-Cola Nationwide, Ending Long-Standing Pepsi Deal •

KFC has announced a significant shift in its beverage offerings, replacing Pepsi with Coca-Cola across all of its U.S. restaurants. This decision marks the end of a nearly 40-year partnership between the fried chicken chain and PepsiCo. The change will take effect immediately, impacting the availability of Pepsi products at the company’s locations. KFC cited a desire to “optimize” its beverage selection as the reason for the transition.

💻 Technology

“Eternal Anima” Revives Classic JRPG Roots with Stunning Modern Design •

Marvelous has revealed “Eternal Anima,” a new original IP returning to the foundations of the Japanese Role-Playing Game genre. The game, initially known as Project Life, draws inspiration from classic JRPGs while incorporating modern design elements. Concept art showcased emphasizes a vibrant, detailed world and character designs. The developers aim to create a respectful homage to the genre’s heritage, blending familiar gameplay with contemporary aesthetics. The game is slated for release on Nintendo Switch.

🎭 Entertainment

Brendan Fraser’s “The Mummy” Sequel Gets New Title, “Book of the Dead” •

Universal Pictures has unveiled the title for Brendan Fraser’s upcoming “Mummy” sequel, officially naming it “The Mummy: Book of the Dead.” The announcement follows a previously undisclosed title for the film. Radio Silence directors Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Ty Simpkins are helming the project, marking a significant shift in creative leadership. The film is slated for release in 2027, continuing the franchise’s exploration of ancient Egyptian mythology.

🏅 Sports

Brewers Manager Unleashes Criticism Following Dodgers’ Postseason Defeat •

The Milwaukee Brewers accepted the National League pennant at Dodger Stadium following the Dodgers’ four-game loss in the National League Championship series. The Dodgers’ season is now over after failing to secure a three-peat. Manager Craig Counsell offered pointed remarks following the defeat, intensifying the criticism of the team’s performance. The Brewers secured their first championship appearance since 1982.

🔬 Science

Penguin Poop Accelerating Antarctic Ice Melt, New Study Reveals •

A recent study published in the Journal of Geophysical Research: Biogeosciences suggests penguin guano is contributing significantly to the melting of Antarctic ice. Researchers found that the high concentrations of nitrogen in the penguin waste are accelerating the melting process by increasing the reflectivity of the ice surface. This “biological forcing” is proving to be a more substantial factor in Antarctic ice loss than previously understood. The study highlights the complex interplay of factors driving climate change in the region.

🩺 Health

New Study Links Gut Bacteria to Increased Risk of Alzheimer’s Disease •

Researchers at the University of Minnesota have identified a specific gut bacteria composition that correlates with an elevated risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease. The study, published in Alzheimer’s & Dementia, examined the gut microbiome of over 150 individuals, including those with and without the disease. Participants with a higher abundance of Desulfovibrio bacteria showed a significantly increased risk of cognitive decline. Scientists believe this bacteria produces compounds that may contribute to inflammation in the brain, a key factor in Alzheimer’s progression.
